notes.title: Patch Notes v1.2
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Added full Xbox controller support and fixed some controller mappings that were wrong in the player's tutorial.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1
notes.content: We have added full German support, fixed a bug in which your language settings would not change, and more languages are on their way!

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0
notes.content:
We have fixed a few bugs, optimized the game, added full Romanian language support and German notes & full UI.
We will be updating the game fully for French, German and Spanish in the next updates. We are sorry for the inconveniences made!
